This policy explains how returns and refunds work at ShopAI Home, an online shop in India selling small home and kitchen appliances. It applies to all items bought on our website. Please read it carefully before you buy.

We want you to be happy with your purchase. If something goes wrong, we will do our best to make it right. This policy tells you what you can return, when, and how refunds are paid. It also covers damage in transit, defects, wrong items, and change-of-mind returns. If you have a question that is not answered here, contact us at support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website.

Throughout this policy, a few words are used in a specific way:
- "We", "us", "our" means ShopAI Home.
- "You", "your" means the customer who placed the order.
- "Item" or "product" means any physical good sold on our website, such as a kettle, mixer grinder, air fryer, coffee maker, toaster, or headphones.
- "Delivery date" means the date the item is shown as delivered by our courier partner. You can find this date in your order confirmation email or in your account on our website.
- "Return window" means 10 days from the delivery date. We explain this in detail in the section "The 10-day return window".
- "Refund" means the money we pay back to you after a return is approved. It can be paid to your original payment method or as store credit, as explained in the section "Refunds: methods and timelines".
- "Store credit" is a balance added to your ShopAI Home account. It can be used for future purchases on our website. It has no expiry date but is not redeemable for cash.

This policy is part of our Terms of Sale. By placing an order, you agree to it. We may update this policy from time to time. The version that applies to your order is the one published on the day you placed the order. We will not reduce your rights under the policy that applied to your purchase.

If any part of this policy is held to be invalid or unenforceable, that part will be modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid, and the rest of the policy will remain in effect.

We comply with the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 and other applicable Indian laws. This policy does not affect any statutory rights you may have under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

Here are some common situations to show how this policy works in practice:
- Ravi orders a mixer grinder. It is delivered on 1 June. He notices it is defective on 8 June. He has until 11 June to request a return, because the 10-day window runs from 2 June to 11 June (10 full days after delivery).
- Priya orders a kettle, but it arrives with a dent from shipping. She takes a clear photo of the damage and requests a return the same day. Her return is approved and a pickup is arranged.
- Anil orders headphones and decides he does not want them. They arrive on 1 July. He opens the box but does not use the headphones. He requests a change-of-mind return on 5 July, keeps the original packaging and all accessories. His return is eligible, but it may be rejected after inspection if the item shows any signs of use or missing parts.
- Simran orders an air fryer, but it is delivered on 15 August. She requests a return on 28 August for change of mind. Her request is rejected because it is more than 10 days after delivery.
- A wrong item is delivered to Vikram. He asks for a return on day 9 after delivery. The return is approved as a wrong item, even though he opened the package, because wrong items are always accepted within the 10-day window.
- An item is marked as delivered on 1 October, but the customer was not at home. The package was left with a security guard. The customer collects it on 4 October and finds it damaged. He requests a return the same day. Even though the delivery date was 1 October, we will consider the date he actually received the item, if he can show a reasonable explanation and photos of the damage.

The table below summarises the main return reasons and what you need to do. Please read the full sections for details.

We know that returns can be stressful. We aim to handle every request fairly and as quickly as possible. If you are unsure whether your item can be returned, please contact us before the 10-day window ends. We are here to help.

Who can return an item

Most items bought from ShopAI Home can be returned by the person who placed the order. If you bought an item as a gift, the person who received it cannot return it – only the original buyer can start a return. This is because the refund goes back to the original payment method or store credit tied to the buyer's account.

To return an item, you must have ordered it from our website or app. Items bought from a physical store, a different online shop, or a third-party seller are not eligible for returns through ShopAI Home. Each order has a unique order ID, which you will find in your confirmation email and in your order history. You will need this order ID when you request a return.

You can return an item if you are the original buyer and the item is still within the return window of 10 days from the delivery date. The return window starts on the day the item is delivered to you, not the day you ordered it. For example, if your air fryer is delivered on 1st June, you can request a return until 10th June, inclusive. If the 10th day falls on a public holiday or weekend, the window still ends on that day – we do not extend the return window for weekends or holidays.

If you paid using a shared account or a family member's card, you can still return the item as long as you are the person who placed the order. For example, if you used your spouse's credit card to buy a mixer grinder, you are the buyer because the order is in your account. The refund will go back to the card that was used, not to your bank account.

If you have moved to a different address since placing the order, you can still return the item. You will need to provide your new address when you request a return, and our pickup partner will collect the item from there. However, returns from a different city may take longer to process, but they are still allowed within the 10-day window.

There are a few situations where you cannot return an item, even if you are the original buyer. If the item has been used, installed, or modified, you cannot return it under the change-of-mind reason. For example, if you have used a coffee maker to brew coffee, it is no longer in original condition, so a change-of-mind return will be rejected. Similarly, if you have unpacked a toaster and used it once, you cannot return it as a change of mind.

If the item arrived damaged, defective, wrong, or not as described, you can return it even if you have opened the box and used it briefly. For example, if a kettle is defective and does not switch off when the water boils, you can return it as defective even if you have used it a few times. However, you must return the item with all its original parts, accessories, and packaging. If you throw away the box or lose a component, we may reject the return or deduct a repackaging fee.

If you order multiple items in one order, you can return one or all of them. For example, if you bought a mixer grinder and a pair of headphones in the same order, you can return just the headphones if they are defective and keep the mixer grinder. Each item is treated separately for returns and refunds.

If you received a free gift with your order, you must return the free gift along with the main item if you want a full refund. If you do not return the free gift, we will deduct its value from your refund. For example, if you bought an air fryer with a free silicone mat, and you return the air fryer but keep the mat, we will deduct the mat's price (usually its listed price on our site) from your refund.

If you have already requested a return and it was approved, you cannot request another return for the same item. Each item can be returned only once per order. For example, if you returned a kettle because it was damaged, and we approved the return, you cannot later try to return the same kettle again for a different reason.

If you are not sure whether you can return an item, contact us before the 10-day window ends. Send an email to support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website. We will tell you if your item is eligible and what steps to take. Do not wait until after the 10-day window, because returns requested after 10 days are automatically rejected.

Most items sold by ShopAI Home can be returned within 10 days from the date of delivery. The return window closes at the end of the 10th day. For example, if your order is delivered on 5 March, you can request a return until the end of 14 March. After that, the return request will be rejected, even if you only miss the deadline by a few hours.

To request a return, you must contact us within the 10-day period. You can do this through the chat on our website or by emailing support@shopai-home.example. The request must reach us before the end of the 10th day. If you email us at 11:45 PM on the 10th day, that still counts. If you email us at 12:05 AM on the 11th day, it is too late.

If your item is delivered in the evening, the 10-day window still starts from that delivery date. Delivery date means the day the courier marks the order as delivered, or if a signature or OTP is required, the day you receive it. If you are not at home and the courier leaves the package with a neighbour or at your doorstep, the delivery date is still that day. We understand that sometimes you may not open the box immediately, but the return window cannot be extended because of this. We recommend opening and checking your item as soon as possible.

The return window applies to all customers, including those who buy as gifts. If you order an item to give to someone else, the 10 days still start from the delivery date to the address on the order. If the gift is not opened until after the window, we cannot accept a return. If you are buying a gift, please plan accordingly.

If you request a return on the 10th day, the return will be accepted for review. It does not matter that the pickup or further inspection happens after the 10-day window. What matters is when you first contacted us. You do not need to have the item picked up by the 10th day. As long as the request is made in time, the process can continue after the window closes.

If your return request is rejected after inspection, the 10-day window does not reset. For example, if you request a change-of-mind return on day 9 and we reject it on day 12 because the item has been used, you cannot make a new request on day 12. The original request was the only one within the window.

If you receive a defective item and ask for a replacement or repair after the 10-day window, that is handled under warranty, not as a return. The 10-day window is for returns, not for warranty claims. You can find more about warranty claims in the section of this policy titled "Warranty claims after the return window".

The 10-day window is the same for all locations in India. Even if you live in a remote area where delivery took the full 10 days, you still have 10 days after delivery to request a return. If delivery took 8 days or more, you may be eligible for goodwill store credit as described in the section "Late deliveries and goodwill credit". This does not change the return window.

If a public holiday or natural disaster prevents you from contacting us within the 10 days, please contact us as soon as possible after the situation is resolved. We may, at our discretion, allow a return if we can verify the circumstances. However, this is not guaranteed, and ordinary delays such as being busy or travelling do not qualify.

If you have ordered multiple items in the same order, each item has its own 10-day window starting from the delivery date of that item. Usually all items in one order are delivered together, but sometimes they are shipped separately. The return window for an item starts when that item is delivered, not when the whole order is delivered.

If you cancel an order before dispatch, it is not a return and the 10-day window does not apply. Cancellations before dispatch are always allowed. You can find more in the section "Cancelling an order and contacting us".

If a courier marks an order as delivered but you have not received it, the return window starts from the date you actually receive it, but you must notify us within 10 days of the courier marking it delivered. We will investigate with the courier. If the item is later found and delivered to you, a new 10-day window starts from that actual delivery date. If the item is lost, we will arrange a replacement or refund as appropriate.

In short: count 10 days from the date the item is delivered, make sure your return request reaches us before the end of the 10th day, and do not delay checking your item when it arrives.

Some items cannot be returned, either because of their nature or because they have been used or damaged after delivery. Please check this list before you request a return.

- Items that have been used, installed, or assembled. For example, a kettle that has been filled with water and switched on, a mixer grinder that has been used even once, an air fryer that has cooked food, or a coffee maker that has brewed a cup.
- Items that are not in their original packaging, or are missing parts, manuals, or accessories. This includes the original product box, inner trays, plastic covers, and any tags or labels.
- Items that show signs of wear, scratches, stains, or damage caused by the customer after delivery. For instance, a toaster with crumbs left inside, or headphones with ear pads that have been used.
- Personal care and hygiene items, such as earphones, earbuds, or any product that comes into direct contact with the body, unless they are returned in a fully sealed and unopened state.
- Items sold as part of a combo or bundle, unless the entire combo or bundle is returned together in its original condition.
- Free gifts or promotional items that came with an order. These cannot be returned separately and will not be refunded or exchanged.
- Products that have been customised, engraved, or altered at the customer's request.
- Items with missing or tampered serial numbers, warranty cards, or holograms.
- Perishable or spoilt goods, if any are sold on the website in the future, will not be returnable.
- Items that become damaged due to misuse, mishandling, or failure to follow the instruction manual. For example, a mixer grinder that is used with the wrong jar or a kettle that is heated without water.
- Electrical items that have been connected to an incorrect voltage or power source.
- Items that have been repaired or attempted to be repaired by anyone other than an authorised service centre.
- Any product for which the return request is made after 10 days from the delivery date, even if it is unused.

Change of mind returns are strictly limited to items that are completely unused, in their original sealed packaging, and with all accessories. If an item fails inspection for any of the above reasons, the return will be rejected and the item will be sent back to you at your cost.

Please note that simply opening the outer shipping carton does not make an item non-returnable. You may open the shipping box to inspect the product, but you must not open the product's own retail packaging if you intend to return it for a change of mind. For example, you can open the brown corrugated box that the mixer grinder was shipped in, but you cannot tear open the glossy box that the mixer grinder itself comes in.

If you received an item that is damaged in transit, defective, wrong, or not as described, the restrictions on opened or used items do not apply. In those cases, you may open the product packaging and inspect the item, and you must provide photos as described in the relevant sections of this policy.

Edge case: You buy a coffee maker and open the retail box to read the manual, but you do not use the machine. You then decide you do not want it. Strictly, the retail packaging has been opened. The return may be rejected after inspection because the item is no longer in its original sealed condition. If you want to return something for a change of mind, please do not open the product's own packaging.

Edge case: You buy a pair of headphones, open the box, try them on for a few minutes, and then decide to return them. Because the headphones have been in contact with your ears, the return will be rejected. Hygiene items are non-returnable once opened.

Edge case: You buy a toaster, use it once, and it works fine. You then change your mind. The return will be rejected because the item has been used.

If you have received an item that is not working correctly but you have used it more than a few times, that may be a warranty claim rather than a return. Please see the section on warranty claims.

We reserve the right to reject a return at any stage if the item does not meet the conditions listed here, even if a return pickup was initially scheduled. You will be informed by email, and the item will be returned to you. If you refuse to accept the item back, we may not be able to offer any refund or credit.

**Items damaged in transit**

If your item arrives damaged, you can return it within 10 days of the delivery date. A damaged-in-transit return is accepted when the item has visible physical damage caused during delivery, such as a cracked outer body, a dented panel, a broken handle, a shattered jar, or internal components rattling inside the box. If the packaging is torn, crushed, or wet, that can also support a damaged-in-transit claim.

To help us process your return quickly, please keep the original packaging and take clear photos of the damage as soon as you notice it. A photo showing the damaged item and, if possible, the damaged packaging is required for all damaged-in-transit claims. Without a photo, we may ask for more information, which can delay the decision.

**Common examples**
- A mixer grinder jar delivered with a crack in the glass or plastic.
- An air fryer basket bent out of shape.
- A kettle with a dented body or a loose, broken base.
- A coffee maker with a cracked water tank.
- A toaster with a broken lever or dented side panels.
- Headphones with a cracked headband or broken ear cup.

**What is not covered as damaged in transit**
- Minor cosmetic scratches or marks that do not affect how the item works.
- Damage caused after delivery, such as accidental drops or misuse.
- Missing accessories or parts that are not listed as damaged on the delivery note.
- Items that are delivered in good condition but stop working later due to a defect. See the section on defective items for that.
- Packaging that is wrinkled or has minor scuffs but the item inside is fine.

**Edge cases**
- *Damage discovered after the courier has left*: You still have 10 days from the delivery date to report it. Take photos and contact us as soon as possible. Delayed reporting may require extra checks.
- *The courier asks you to sign before opening*: You can still open the package and inspect the item after signing. If you find damage, take photos and request a return within 10 days. Signing the delivery note does not waive your right to return a damaged item.
- *Partial damage*: If only one part of a multi-part product is damaged (for example, one jar of a mixer grinder set is cracked but the motor works), you can still return the whole product. We cannot send a replacement part for a damaged-in-transit claim.
- *The box is damaged but the item looks fine*: If the item itself is not damaged, a damaged box alone is not a valid reason for a damaged-in-transit return. You can still request a return for change of mind if it is unused and in original condition.
- *The item is damaged and also fails to switch on*: If the item is both physically damaged and not working, choose the reason that best fits. If you select damaged in transit, include photos of the damage. If the item does not work but has no visible damage, see the section on defective items.
- *Liquid spillage inside the package*: If a kettle or coffee maker leaks water or any liquid inside the box during delivery, that counts as damaged in transit. Take photos of the wet packaging and the item, and do not plug in or use the item.
- *Damage to an accessory*: If a non-essential accessory like a measuring spoon or a cleaning brush arrives broken, but the main product is fine, you can still report a damaged-in-transit claim. We will inspect and decide whether to accept the return of the full product.

**What happens after you request a return for damage**
When you request a return, you will be asked to upload a photo of the damage. If the photo is not clear, we may ask for more photos or a short video showing the damage. Once you submit the request, the status will be **pending** while we review the details. If we need more information, we will contact you by email or chat.

If the claim is approved, we will arrange a pickup from your delivery address. Please keep the item and all accessories in the original packaging, if possible. Do not use the item or try to repair it. The courier will collect the package, and after we receive it, we will inspect it. If everything matches the claim, the return is **approved**, and your refund will be processed as described in the refunds section. If the inspection shows that the damage was not caused during transit, the return may be **rejected**, and we will explain why in writing. You can ask for a second review if you disagree, but we may require additional evidence.

If you receive a damaged item and the delivery took 8 days or more, you may also be eligible for a goodwill store credit of about 10% of the order value, as described in the late deliveries section. This goodwill credit is separate from the refund for the damaged item. If you return the damaged item for a refund, you can still receive the goodwill credit if the delivery was late.

**Important reminders**
- Always keep photos of the damage. Without a photo, we cannot accept a damaged-in-transit claim.
- Do not throw away the original packaging until the return is completed.
- Report the damage within 10 days of delivery. After 10 days, we will not accept a damaged-in-transit claim.
- If you have any questions, contact us at support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website.

If the item you received does not work properly out of the box, stops working within a short period of normal use, or shows a manufacturing fault, it may be defective. This section explains how we handle defective items within the 10-day return window.

A defective item is one that fails to perform its basic function, has a fault that affects normal use, or arrives with a defect that was not mentioned in the product description. Examples include a kettle that does not heat water, a mixer grinder whose motor does not start, an air fryer that does not switch on, a coffee maker that leaks from the base, a toaster that does not pop up, or headphones where one side produces no sound.

Defects caused by accident, misuse, normal wear and tear, or unauthorised repairs are not covered. For example, if a mixer grinder stops working because the jar was dropped, or if a kettle fails because it was used to boil milk against the instructions, we cannot accept it as defective under this policy.

If you think your item is defective, please request a return within 10 days of delivery. Go to your order history on the website, select the item, choose the return reason as "defective", and describe the fault clearly. For example, write "the air fryer's fan does not spin" or "the coffee maker does not heat the water". If possible, include a short video or a few clear photos showing the problem. This helps us approve your return faster.

After you submit the return request, we will arrange a pickup. Our courier will collect the item from the address on your order. Please pack the item securely, preferably in its original box with all accessories, manuals, and any free items that came with it. If the item is not packed safely and gets further damaged during return transit, we may reject the return.

Once the item reaches us, our inspection team will check it. If the defect is confirmed, we will approve the return and process a refund. If the item is found to be working correctly, or if the defect was caused by misuse or damage not present at delivery, we will reject the return and send the item back to you. You will not be charged for the return shipping when the item is confirmed defective.

Edge cases:
- An item that arrives with a visible manufacturing flaw, such as a cracked body or a missing knob, is treated as defective. You may also report it as damaged in transit if the packaging was damaged. Choose the reason that best fits what you observed.
- If a defect appears after a few days of light use, for example a kettle that leaks after three boils, you can still return it as defective within the 10-day window. We will inspect it and approve the return if the fault is a manufacturing defect.
- If the defect is intermittent, such as headphones that cut out occasionally, describe the issue in detail and, if possible, record a short video when the fault occurs. Our inspection team will test the item. If we cannot reproduce the fault, we may send the item back. In such cases, we suggest you try the item with a different power socket, cable, or device before requesting a return.
- If the item was part of a combo or bundle, return the entire set. For example, if a mixer grinder came with extra jars and the motor is defective, include all jars and accessories in the return. A partial return may lead to rejection.
- If the item is large or heavy, such as a big air fryer, the pickup will still be arranged at no cost to you. You do not need to carry it to a drop-off point.
- If your item is found defective after the 10-day return window has passed, this section does not apply. Please refer to the section "Warranty claims after the return window" for how to get it repaired or replaced under the one-year warranty (two years for mixer grinder motors).

Refund for a defective item is processed in the same way as for other approved returns. The refund is paid within 10 days of the return being requested and approved. The refund goes to the original payment method for UPI, card, and net banking orders. For cash-on-delivery orders, the refund is issued as store credit. You may also choose store credit instead of a bank refund for any order. The refund will never exceed what you paid for the item, including any discounts applied.

If you have already started using the item and then it becomes defective, you can still return it. For example, if you used a coffee maker twice and it stopped working on the third use, that is a defective item eligible for return within 10 days. The item does not need to be unused for a defective return, but it must be in a condition that allows inspection. We understand that some use will have occurred.

Please keep the original packaging, even after you start using the product. You will need it for a safe return if the item turns out to be defective. If you no longer have the original box, pack the item in a sturdy carton with enough cushioning, such as bubble wrap or newspaper. Write your return request number on the outside of the box.

If a defective item caused damage to your property, such as a leaking kettle damaging a table, please contact our support team immediately. This policy covers the return and refund of the item, but any claim for property damage is handled separately and may require additional information. We will assess such claims on a case-by-case basis.

For any questions about defective items, contact support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website. We are here to help.

If you receive an item that is not what you ordered, or your order arrives with items missing, please tell us as soon as possible within the 10-day return window. We will put things right.

Wrong items

A wrong item is any product that does not match what you ordered. For example: you ordered a 1.5-litre kettle but received a 1-litre kettle; you ordered a black coffee maker but received a white one; you ordered a mixer grinder but received a toaster; or you ordered a 750-watt mixer grinder but received a 500-watt model.

If you receive a wrong item, you must not use it. Using the item may affect our ability to accept the return, because we cannot resell a used item and we may not be able to confirm it was wrong. Please keep the item, its box, and all accessories and manuals in the condition they arrived.

You will have the option to return the wrong item for a full refund, or to ask for a replacement. We will arrange a return pickup at no cost to you. We inspect the item when it comes back to us. If we confirm it is wrong, we approve your refund or send the correct replacement. We aim to send replacements as quickly as possible, usually within a few days of approving the return, but it may take longer if stock is delayed. If the correct item is no longer available, we will refund you in full.

Incomplete items

An order is incomplete if any item you paid for is missing from the parcel, or if an item is missing essential parts or accessories that should be in the box. For example: you ordered two items but received only one; you received a kettle without its base; you received a mixer grinder without its jars; or you received air fryer without its basket.

Sometimes an item is sent in more than one parcel and they may arrive on different days. If you receive only part of your order, please wait until the expected delivery window has ended before reporting it as incomplete. Delivery normally takes 1 to 10 days after ordering, so if only part of your order has arrived by day 10, tell us then.

If an essential part or accessory is missing from an item's box, please report it as soon as you notice. Do not use the item without that part if doing so could damage the item or make it unsafe. We will first check whether we can send the missing part separately, such as a kettle lid, a mixer grinder jar, or an air fryer basket. If we cannot send the part, we will arrange a return of the whole item for a refund or replacement.

How to report a wrong or incomplete item

To report a wrong or incomplete item, contact us through the chat on our website or by emailing support@shopai-home.example. Please include your order number, a clear description of what you received or what is missing, and a photo showing the item or items you received next to their packaging. Photos help us confirm the issue quickly. We may also ask for a photo of the outer box and the shipping label.

For a missing item, we may check the weight of the parcel as recorded by the courier, and we may ask the courier for delivery details. This helps us confirm whether the item was ever packed. We will do this as quickly as we can, but it may take a few days.

If we confirm that your order was wrong or incomplete, we will offer you a choice: a full refund for the wrong or missing item, or a replacement at no extra cost. We will also refund any delivery charge you paid for the item, if applicable. If you choose a refund, it is paid within 10 days of the request being approved, and it never exceeds what you paid for the order. Refunds go back to your original payment method, except cash-on-delivery orders, which are refunded as store credit. You may always choose store credit instead of a refund to your original payment method.

Edge cases and important notes

- If you ordered several items and only one is wrong or missing, we will refund or replace only that item, not the entire order, unless you ask to return other items under a change of mind within the 10-day window.
- If you received a free gift or promotional item that is wrong or missing, tell us. We will try to send the correct gift or a similar item, but gifts are not refundable for cash.
- If you report a wrong or missing item after the 10-day return window, we may still help if we can confirm the issue from our records. However, we treat late reports with much more caution, and we may reject the claim if too much time has passed.
- If the outer packaging was damaged when you received it, and an item is missing or wrong, please keep the packaging and take clear photos before opening. This helps us claim from the courier.
- If you ordered a product that comes in multiple boxes (for example, a mixer grinder with extra jars shipped separately), missing one box is an incomplete order. Keep all boxes you did receive in their original condition until we resolve the issue.
- We never ask you to pay extra for a replacement or for a corrected order caused by our mistake. If anyone asks you to pay, refuse and tell us.

We are sorry when we send a wrong or incomplete item. We will put it right as quickly as we can, and we thank you for your patience.

You can request a return within 10 days of delivery if you change your mind about a product. This is called a change-of-mind return.

For a change-of-mind return to be accepted, the item must be unused, in its original condition, and in its original packaging with all accessories, manuals, and warranty cards. If the item has been used, shows signs of wear, is missing parts, or is not in its original packaging, we may reject the return.

Examples of acceptable change-of-mind returns:
- You ordered a kettle but decided you prefer a different colour or model before using it. You return the kettle unopened in its sealed box.
- You bought a mixer grinder but realised your existing one still works well. You return the mixer grinder without having plugged it in or removed any protective films.
- You purchased an air fryer but later found it too large for your kitchen counter. You return the air fryer with all its parts and packaging intact.

Examples of change-of-mind returns that are likely to be rejected after inspection:
- A coffee maker that has been used once and still has coffee residue or water droplets inside.
- A toaster with breadcrumbs in the crumb tray, even if you wiped the outside.
- A pair of headphones with ear cushions that show signs of being worn, such as creases or skin oils.
- A product returned without its original box, or with a damaged box that reduces its resale value.

Change-of-mind returns are more often rejected after inspection than other types of returns. We inspect every returned item to check that it meets the conditions above. If the item does not meet these conditions, we will reject the return and send the item back to you. You may be asked to bear the cost of return shipping if the item does not meet the conditions.

If your change-of-mind return is approved, we will refund the amount you paid for the item. Refunds are made to the original payment method or as store credit, as described in the section on refunds. Please note that refunds never exceed what you paid for the order.

For cash-on-delivery orders, change-of-mind returns are refunded as store credit only. If you paid by UPI, card, or net banking, you may choose between a refund to the original payment method or store credit.

We will then arrange a pickup or ask you to ship the item back. Please keep the item safely until it is collected, and do not use it further while the return is being processed.

If you have any questions about whether your item qualifies for a change-of-mind return, please contact us before starting the return. You can email support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website.

- For wrong or incomplete items, tell us what you received instead of what you ordered.

For change-of-mind returns, the item must be unused, in original condition, with all accessories, manuals, and warranty cards. If anything is missing or the item shows signs of use, we may reject your return after inspection.

For damaged or defective items, keep your photos and any other evidence until your refund is issued. For wrong items, do not use the product; keep it safe and repackage it as you received it. For incomplete items, tell us which part is missing, and we will first check if we can send the missing part instead of a full return.

If your return is approved after pickup and inspection, we will process your refund within 10 days from the date your return was approved. For example, if we approve your return on 10 April, you should see your refund by 20 April.

Edge cases: If your delivery was delayed by 8 days or more, you may be eligible for a goodwill store credit of about 10% of the order value. This does not affect your right to return the item within 10 days of delivery. To claim both, please request the return first, then ask us about the goodwill credit separately.

If you paid by cash on delivery, your refund will be issued as store credit. You may also choose store credit for any payment method, for example, if you plan to buy something else from us. Please tell us your preference when you request the return.

Remember, refunds never exceed what you paid for the order. If you used a discount code, your refund will be for the amount you actually paid, not the original list price.

If you return an item from a multi-item order but keep the rest, we will refund only the price of the returned item, including any applicable taxes, but not the full order total.

For returns due to damage, defect, wrong item, or not as described, we will not charge you any pickup or restocking fees. For change-of-mind returns, we may deduct a small restocking fee, but we will tell you before you agree to the return.

If the pickup has already happened, you cannot cancel; we will continue with the inspection and refund if approved.

If you have any questions about requesting a return, write to us at support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website. We are here to help.

When you request a return, we arrange a pickup from the address where the item was delivered. Our courier partner will contact you on the contact number provided at the time of ordering. Please keep the item and its original packaging ready. If the original packaging is not available, use any sturdy box with adequate padding to prevent damage during transit back to us.

After the item is picked up, it goes to our returns centre for inspection. Inspection usually takes 2 working days from the date we receive the item. During this time, the status of your return will show as "pending" in your account. Once inspection is complete, the status changes to "approved" or "rejected". You will receive an email at the address linked to your order with the decision and the reason.

What we check during inspection
- For damage in transit: We verify the photos you uploaded and compare them with the physical condition of the item. The item must show damage consistent with the photos. If the damage looks different or the item is in working condition, the return may be rejected.
- For defective items: We test the item if possible. For electronics like kettles, air fryers, or headphones, we check if they power on and perform basic functions. For mixer grinders, we check the motor, jars, and blades. If the defect is not found during testing, the return may be rejected.

If the item shows signs of use, such as scratches, stains, or smells, or if any accessory is missing, the return is likely to be rejected. If your return is rejected after inspection, we will return the item to you at no additional cost. You will receive an email with the reason for rejection and the expected delivery date of the item back to your address. If the item is not accepted by you upon return delivery, we will hold it for 7 days before discarding it. Edge cases
- If you received the wrong item and the correct item is still available in stock, we may offer a replacement instead of a refund. In that case, inspection verifies the wrong item condition and then we arrange dispatch of the correct item. The 10-day return window does not apply to the replacement item; it has its own 10-day window from its delivery.

- If the item was a free gift or promotional add-on, you only need to return the main item if that is what you are returning. The free gift can be kept, but the refund amount will not include the value of the gift.

We aim to make inspection fair and quick. If you disagree with an inspection decision, you can reply to the email we send, explaining your concern. We will review it once. The review decision is final.

Refunds are paid within 10 days of the date your return is requested and approved. For example, if you request a return on 1 March and we approve it on the same day, the refund will reach you by 11 March. If we need to inspect the item first, the 10 days start after approval, not after request.

If your return is rejected after inspection, no refund will be issued. We will explain the reason and, if possible, offer to return the item to you at no extra cost.

Common questions

Edge cases and examples

Late deliveries and goodwill credit

Our normal delivery time is 1 to 10 days after you place your order. Most orders arrive well within this window, but occasionally there may be delays due to factors beyond our control, such as weather, courier issues, or high demand.

If your order takes 8 days or more to be delivered, we may offer you a goodwill store credit of about 10% of the order value. This credit is a gesture of apology for the wait and is not a refund of your payment. It will be added to your ShopAI Home account after your order is delivered, and you can use it on any future purchase.

Here are some examples to illustrate how this works:

- You order a kettle for ₹1,200. It is delivered on day 9. We may give you a goodwill credit of around ₹120 (10% of the order value).
- You order an air fryer for ₹8,000. It is delivered on day 7. No goodwill credit applies because delivery was within 7 days.
- You order a mixer grinder for ₹4,500. It is delivered on day 10, exactly 10 days after ordering. Since the delay is exactly 8 days or more, we may offer a goodwill credit of about ₹450. Delivery on day 10 is still within our normal range, but because it reached 8 days or more, the goodwill gesture may apply.
- You order headphones for ₹2,000. It is delivered on day 11, which is beyond our normal 10-day window. In such a case, the order is already late, and we may offer a goodwill credit of about ₹200. - If you return the item after a late delivery, any goodwill credit already issued may be cancelled or adjusted. For example, if you receive a ₹200 goodwill credit for a late delivery, then later return the item for a refund, we will deduct the ₹200 from your refund amount or cancel the credit if unused.
- Goodwill credit expires 6 months from the date it is issued. We will remind you before it expires.
- Goodwill credit is offered at our discretion. It is not a guaranteed compensation, and we may not offer it in all cases. For example, if the delay was caused by you (e.g., incorrect address, refused delivery, or you were unavailable to receive the package), we will not offer goodwill credit.

What to do if your order is late:

If your order has not arrived within 8 days, please contact us through the chat on our website or email support@shopai-home.example. We will track your package and let you know the expected delivery date. If the delay qualifies, we will automatically add the goodwill credit to your account after delivery, or we may issue it earlier in some cases.

We appreciate your patience, and we always aim to deliver your items as quickly as possible.

If a product develops a fault after the 10-day return window has closed, you may still be covered under our warranty. All products sold by ShopAI Home come with a 1-year warranty from the date of delivery. The motor of a mixer grinder is covered for 2 years from the date of delivery.

What the warranty covers

The warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use. It does not cover accidental damage, misuse, normal wear and tear, or problems caused by not following the instruction manual. For example, if your kettle stops heating water within 6 months of delivery and you have used it normally with a voltage stabiliser, that is likely a valid warranty claim. But if you dropped the kettle and the casing cracked, that is not covered.

How to make a warranty claim

To make a warranty claim, contact us at support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website. Please tell us your order number, the date of delivery, and a clear description of the fault. If the fault is visible, such as a cracked mixer jar or a toaster lever that does not stay down, attach photos or a short video. This helps us resolve your claim faster.

We will review your claim and may ask for more details. In some cases, we may arrange for the product to be picked up for inspection. If we find a covered defect, we will repair the product or replace it with the same or an equivalent model. If neither repair nor replacement is possible, we may issue a refund as store credit.

Examples and edge cases

- Example 1: You bought a coffee maker and it worked for 3 weeks. On day 40 after delivery, it stops switching on. The return window has closed, but the 1-year warranty applies. Tell us the order number and describe the problem. We may ask you to try a different socket and check the plug. If that does not help, we will guide you through the next steps.
- Example 2: Your air fryer's digital display shows an error code 9 months after delivery. This is within the 1-year warranty. We may ask for a video of the error. If the fault is covered, we will arrange repair or replacement.
- Example 3: The motor of your mixer grinder stops working 18 months after delivery. The product warranty is 1 year, but the motor warranty is 2 years. So this fault is still covered if it is a motor defect and not due to misuse.
- Edge case: You bought a toaster and it worked for 15 months. The heating elements stop working. The 1-year warranty has expired, and the fault occurred after that period. We cannot offer a free repair or replacement. But we may be able to offer a discount on a new purchase at our discretion. This is not part of the warranty policy.

What is not covered

- The warranty does not extend the 10-day return window. If your product is faulty on delivery, you should request a return within 10 days as described in the section about defective items. After 10 days, your only remedy for defects is the warranty.
- The warranty does not cover accessories or consumable parts unless they are included in the original defect. For example, the blades of a mixer grinder may wear out with normal use, and this is not covered unless the blade breaks due to a material defect in the first few weeks.
- The warranty is only for products bought from ShopAI Home in India. If you bought the product elsewhere or are outside India, this warranty does not apply.
- The warranty is non-transferable. It applies only to the original purchaser named in the order.

Timeline and process for warranty claims

- We aim to respond to warranty claims within 2 business days.
- If we need to inspect the product, we will arrange a pickup. Pickup is free within the first 6 months of delivery. After 6 months, you may need to send the product to our service centre at your own cost, or we may arrange pickup with a charge. We will tell you before any charges apply.
- Repairs usually take 7 to 14 days from receipt of the product. Replacement, if approved, is usually shipped within 5 to 7 days after we approve the claim.
- If we cannot repair or replace the product, we may issue store credit equal to the current selling price of the product, not more than what you paid. Store credit has no expiry.

Keep proof of purchase and delivery

Your order confirmation email and delivery date are your proof of warranty. Keep them safe. We may ask for your order number at any time during the warranty period. If you cannot provide the order number, we may not be able to help.

Choosing repair or replacement

We decide whether to repair or replace based on the fault and product availability. If the product is no longer sold, we may offer a similar model. If you want a refund instead of repair or replacement, we will consider it only if repair and replacement are not possible.

sections.Safety: Please read all instructions before using your ShopAI Home electric kettle. This appliance is intended for household use only, for boiling water. Do not use it for any other purpose. Always place the kettle on a flat, stable, dry surface away from the edge of the counter. Keep the kettle, base, and cord away from hot surfaces, open flames, and water splashes. Do not immerse the kettle, base, cord, or plug in water or any other liquid. Ensure your hands are dry before connecting or disconnecting the appliance. Never operate the kettle with a damaged cord or plug, or after the appliance malfunctions or has been dropped or damaged in any way. Contact our support team for examination or repair. Do not attempt to repair the appliance yourself; doing so will void the warranty. Use only the base provided with the kettle. Do not use the kettle without water, and do not overfill beyond the maximum mark; boiling water may spill out. Always ensure the lid is securely closed before switching on. Never open the lid while the water is boiling or immediately after, as escaping steam can cause burns. Keep the kettle out of reach of children. Children should be supervised to ensure they do not play with the appliance. This appliance is not intended for use by persons with reduced physical, sensory, or mental capabilities, or lack of experience and knowledge, unless they have been given supervision or instruction. If the supply cord is damaged, it must be replaced by the manufacturer, its service agent, or similarly qualified persons to avoid a hazard. The kettle will automatically switch off once the water reaches a rolling boil, but you may also switch it off manually by lifting the switch to the off position. Always unplug the base from the wall socket when not in use and before cleaning. Allow the kettle to cool down completely before cleaning or storing. Do not fill the kettle when it is hot. Do not use an extension cord unless it is rated for the power consumption of the kettle. Use only in dry indoor locations. Save these instructions.
sections.Setup: Remove all packaging materials from the kettle and base. Check that the voltage indicated on the rating label matches your mains supply. Place the base on a flat, stable, heat-resistant surface. Unwind the power cord from the storage area under the base and route it through the cord exit slot so the base sits level. Plug the cord into the base if it is detachable, then plug the base into a wall socket. Before first use, clean the kettle by filling it with water to the maximum mark, boiling, and then discarding the water. Repeat this process once more to remove any manufacturing residues. Your kettle is now ready for everyday use. To remove the kettle from the base, lift it vertically. To place it back, align the kettle with the base and set it down gently; it will connect automatically. Some models have a 360-degree rotational base, allowing you to place the kettle at any angle. If your model has a water level window, check that it is clearly visible and clean. For kettles with a removable filter, ensure the filter is fitted correctly before use. The kettle should only be connected to a power supply after being correctly placed on its base. Do not operate the kettle on a tilted surface. Ensure the lid is closed securely before switching on. Some models have a power indicator light that illuminates when the kettle is on. The switch may be located on the handle or the base, depending on the model. Read the symbols on the switch: 'I' means on and 'O' means off. After boiling, lift the kettle from the base before pouring. Never pour water while the kettle is still on the base. Ensure the base is unplugged when not in use. If your kettle has a cord wrap, wind the cord loosely around it to avoid damage.
sections.Everyday use: Open the lid and fill the kettle with the desired amount of fresh, cold water. Use the water level indicator to avoid overfilling; never exceed the maximum mark or go below the minimum mark if your model has one. Close the lid firmly. Place the kettle on the base. Insert the plug into the wall socket and switch on if there is a separate power switch on the base. Press the on/off switch to start heating; the indicator light will glow. The kettle will automatically switch off once the water boils. You may also switch it off manually at any time. Wait a few seconds for the water to settle before pouring. Lift the kettle by the handle and pour slowly to avoid splashes. Keep the lid closed while pouring. If you want to reboil, check the water level and add more if necessary. Always use fresh water for boiling; do not reboil water more than once for best taste. Never operate the kettle with an empty heating chamber. If the kettle accidentally switches on with no water, the boil-dry protection will turn it off. Allow it to cool for at least 15 minutes before refilling. The outside of the kettle becomes hot during use; touch only the handle and controls. Do not cover the kettle or base with any cloth or object while in operation. Unplug the kettle from the wall socket when not in use. For safety, do not leave the kettle unattended while boiling. If you hear unusual sounds such as popping or crackling, this is normal scale expansion; clean the kettle regularly. Store the kettle in a dry place, with the cord loosely coiled. If your model has a cordless design, ensure the kettle is fully cooled before storing it on the base. Use the kettle only for boiling water; do not heat milk, tea, or other liquids directly in it.
sections.Cleaning and care: Always unplug the base from the wall socket and allow the kettle to cool completely before cleaning. Never immerse the kettle, base, cord, or plug in water or any other liquid. Wipe the exterior with a soft, damp cloth. Do not use abrasive cleaners, scouring pads, or chemical solvents, as they may damage the surface. sections.Setup: Before using your mixer grinder for the first time, remove all packaging materials and check that all parts are present. Your package includes the motor base, one or more jars with lids, and a user manual. Wash all jars, lids, and blades with warm soapy water, rinse well, and dry thoroughly. Wipe the motor base with a soft, dry cloth. Never immerse the motor base in water or any other liquid. Place the motor base on a clean, dry, level surface such as a kitchen counter. Ensure there is enough space around the appliance for air circulation. Plug the power cord into a suitable electrical socket. Do not switch on the appliance until the jar is correctly assembled and placed on the motor base. To assemble a jar, first place the blade assembly onto the jar base if it is not already fixed. Screw the jar base firmly onto the jar. Ensure the rubber gasket is in place to prevent leakage. Fill the jar with ingredients, but do not exceed the maximum capacity mark. Place the lid on the jar and press it down firmly. Some models have a safety interlock; ensure the lid is properly locked in place. Place the assembled jar onto the motor base, aligning the jar handle with the arrow or marking on the base. Turn the jar clockwise until it locks into position. If the jar is not seated correctly, the motor will not start. You are now ready to use the appliance. For the initial use, it is recommended to run the mixer grinder empty for a few seconds to ensure it operates smoothly. Do not run it for more than a few seconds empty. After this quick test, switch off and unplug the appliance. Now fill the jar with your ingredients and proceed as described in the Everyday use section. If you find that the jar does not lock easily, check for any obstruction and try again. Never force the jar onto the base. Keep the appliance clean and dry at all times. Read the Safety section thoroughly before first use.
sections.Everyday use: To use your mixer grinder, first ensure the appliance is unplugged. Select the appropriate jar for your task: use the large jar for wet grinding, such as batters and chutneys; the medium jar for dry grinding spices; and the small jar for chutneys or small quantities. Add your ingredients to the jar. For best results, cut large ingredients into smaller pieces before adding. Do not fill the jar beyond the maximum level. Close the lid securely. Place the jar onto the motor base and turn it to lock. Plug in the appliance. Switch on the power using the main switch, if provided. Then select the desired speed or function: low, medium, high, or pulse. For most tasks, start with a low speed and increase as needed. Use the pulse function for short bursts to control the texture. For wet grinding, add a little water or oil to aid blending. Do not run the appliance continuously for more than 3 minutes at a time; allow it to rest for a minute between cycles. If the motor stops suddenly, it may have overheated. Switch off, unplug, and allow it to cool for 30 minutes before resuming. While the appliance is running, do not insert any utensils into the jar. To add ingredients during operation, remove the small cap from the lid (if available) and drop them through the opening, then replace the cap. When the desired consistency is achieved, switch off the appliance, unplug it, and wait for the blades to stop completely. Then unlock and remove the jar from the base. Open the lid and pour out the contents. Use a spatula to remove any remaining mixture, being careful of the sharp blades. Never put your fingers inside the jar. After use, clean the jar and lid as described in the Cleaning and care section. For dry grinding, ensure the jar is completely dry before adding ingredients. Grind in short bursts to avoid overheating the ingredients. If the mixture sticks to the sides, stop and scrape down with a spatula. Do not run the appliance empty. Follow these simple steps for efficient and long-lasting performance.
sections.Cleaning and care: Always unplug the appliance and wait for the blades to stop before cleaning. Do not immerse the motor base in water or any other liquid. To clean the motor base, wipe it with a soft, damp cloth and dry with a clean towel. Never use abrasive cleaners, steel wool, or harsh chemicals on any part of the appliance. Clean the jars, lids, and blade assemblies after each use to prevent staining and odours. For jars with fixed blades, fill the jar halfway with warm water and a drop of mild dish soap. Place the jar on the motor base, secure the lid, and run the appliance for a few seconds. Then pour out the soapy water and rinse thoroughly with clean water. Alternatively, wash the jar by hand with a soft brush, being careful of the sharp blades. Do not put the jars in a dishwasher unless specifically marked as dishwasher safe. For jars with detachable blades, unscrew the blade assembly from the jar base. Wash all parts in warm soapy water, rinse, and dry completely before reassembling. Ensure the rubber gasket is cleaned and replaced correctly to prevent leakage. Dry all parts completely before storing. Store the appliance with the jars unlocked and the lids off to prevent odours. If stubborn stains remain, make a paste of baking soda and water, apply to the stain, leave for 10 minutes, and scrub gently. For unpleasant smells, blend a mixture of water and lemon juice or vinegar in the jar, then rinse well. Do not use the appliance to blend hot liquids. Never place any part of the mixer grinder in a microwave oven. Keep the appliance away from direct sunlight and moisture. Check the power cord regularly for damage. If the cord is damaged, discontinue use and contact ShopAI Home support. Follow these guidelines to maintain your mixer grinder in good working condition and to ensure food safety.
sections.Troubleshooting:
Here are some common problems you may encounter with your mixer grinder and how to fix them.

- Problem: The appliance does not start. Fix: Check that the power cord is plugged into a working socket. Ensure the jar is correctly placed and locked on the motor base; the safety interlock prevents operation if the jar is not seated properly. Check the lid is closed correctly. If the motor is overheated, wait 30 minutes for it to cool.

- Problem: The motor hums but the blades do not turn. Fix: Switch off immediately and unplug. Remove the jar and check for blockages. If the blades are jammed by hard ingredients, remove some contents and add a little water. Never force the blades.

- Problem: The jar leaks during use. Fix: Ensure the rubber gasket is properly seated and not damaged. Tighten the blade assembly or jar base firmly. Do not overfill the jar beyond the maximum mark.

- Problem: The appliance vibrates excessively. Fix: Ensure the appliance is on a flat, stable surface. Do not overload the jar. Check that the jar is locked straight and not tilted.

- Problem: Food is not ground evenly. Fix: Cut ingredients into smaller pieces before grinding. Fill the jar to an appropriate level—not too full or too empty. Use short pulse bursts for better control.

- Problem: The appliance stops suddenly during use. Fix: The thermal cut-out may have tripped due to overheating. Unplug and let it cool for at least 30 minutes before trying again. Reduce the batch size or running time.

- Problem: The blades are dull or damaged. Fix: Do not use the appliance if blades are damaged. Contact ShopAI Home support for replacement advice.

- Problem: Unpleasant odour in the jar. Fix: Blend a solution of water and lemon juice or baking soda, then rinse thoroughly. Dry completely before storing with the lid off.

If the problem persists, do not attempt to repair the appliance yourself. Contact ShopAI Home support at support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website.

sections.Safety:
Please read all instructions before using your ShopAI Home air fryer. This appliance is for household use only. Keep it away from water and other liquids. Do not immerse the cord, plug, or unit in water. Unplug when not in use and before cleaning. Allow it to cool before putting on or taking off parts. Do not operate with a damaged cord or plug. If it malfunctions or is dropped or damaged in any way, contact our support team at support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website. Do not attempt to repair it yourself.

Place the air fryer on a stable, level, heat-resistant surface. Keep it at least 15 cm away from walls and other objects. Do not place it under overhead cupboards or near curtains. Never cover the air vents. Hot air comes out of the exhaust during cooking; keep hands and face away. Use the handle to remove the basket. The basket, tray, and inside of the appliance get very hot. Always use oven gloves or a heat-proof pad.

Do not fill the basket with oil or any liquid. This is not a deep fryer. Only put food in the basket. Never put the appliance on a hob, even an induction one, or in a heated oven. Do not put anything on top of the appliance while in use. Do not leave it unattended. Keep the cord away from hot surfaces and do not let it hang over the edge of the worktop. This appliance can be used by children aged 8 and above and persons with reduced physical, sensory or mental capabilities if they have been given supervision or instruction concerning use in a safe way and understand the hazards. Children must not play with the appliance. Cleaning and user maintenance should not be done by children unless they are older than 8 and supervised. Keep the appliance and cord out of reach of children under 8.
sections.Setup:
Before first use, remove all packaging, stickers, and labels from the air fryer. Check that the voltage on the rating label matches your mains supply. Wash the basket and tray in warm soapy water, rinse and dry fully. Wipe the inside and outside of the main unit with a soft damp cloth. Do not immerse the main unit in water.

Place the air fryer on a stable, level, heat-resistant surface, away from walls, curtains, and other appliances. Leave at least 15 cm of space on all sides and above. Plug it in. The display or control dials will light up. Your model may have digital touch controls or manual dials, but the basic process is the same.

Before cooking food, run the air fryer empty for about 10 minutes at 200°C to burn off any manufacturing residue. This may produce a slight odour or light smoke; that is normal. Open a window or turn on an extractor fan. After this, let it cool, then wipe the inside again.

You do not need to preheat the air fryer for most foods. If your model has a preheat function, it will tell you when it is ready. Place the food in the basket; do not overfill. For best results, leave space between pieces for air to circulate. Insert the basket fully into the unit. Set the temperature and time according to the recipe or the guide that came with your model. Press start. You can remove the basket at any time to shake or check food; cooking will pause on most models and resume when you replace the basket. When done, remove the basket carefully and place it on a heat-proof surface. Use tongs or a spoon to remove food. Always unplug after use.
sections.Everyday use:
Using your air fryer every day is simple. Place the food in the basket and slide it back into the unit. Select the temperature and time using the controls. As a guide, most foods cook well at 180°C to 200°C. For chips or other small items, shake the basket halfway through cooking. For larger items, turn them over. Cooking times vary by model and food amount. Check food a few minutes before the set time to avoid overcooking. You can always add more time if needed.

Do not put wet batter or very wet food in the basket; it will drip. Pat food dry before cooking. Brush or spray a little oil on food for a crispier result. Do not use aerosol cooking spray inside the basket; it can damage the non-stick coating. Use a refillable oil sprayer or brush a thin layer of oil.

Some models have preset programmes for common foods like chips, chicken, fish, or cake. These are starting points; adjust if needed. If your model has a digital display, use the + and - buttons to set time and temperature. For manual dials, turn the dials to the desired settings.

The air fryer works best when the basket is not overcrowded. Stacking too much food results in uneven cooking. For best results, cook in a single layer. If you have a large amount, cook in batches.

After cooking, remove the basket carefully. The basket and food are very hot. Place the basket on a heat-proof mat or trivet. Do not put it directly on a delicate worktop. Use silicone or wooden utensils to remove food to protect the non-stick coating. Never use metal tongs or forks inside the basket. Empty any crumbs or oil from the basket after it cools.
sections.Cleaning and care:
Clean your air fryer after every use to prevent build-up of grease and food residue. Always unplug the appliance and let it cool completely before cleaning. Do not immerse the main unit, cord, or plug in water or any liquid. Wipe the outside and inside of the main unit with a soft, damp cloth. For stubborn stains, use a mild detergent on the cloth, then wipe with a clean damp cloth. Dry thoroughly.

The basket and tray are usually dishwasher safe on the top rack; check the care label on your model. Alternatively, wash them in warm soapy water with a soft sponge or brush. Do not use steel wool, abrasive cleaners, or scouring pads; they will scratch the non-stick coating. If food is stuck, soak the basket in warm soapy water for 10–15 minutes, then wash. Rinse and dry fully before placing back in the unit.

The heating element inside the top of the unit may collect grease over time. To clean it, let the unit cool, then wipe the element gently with a soft, dry brush or a damp cloth. Do not use water directly on the element. If you notice any odour, mix a paste of bicarbonate of soda and water, apply to the basket and tray, leave for 10 minutes, then rinse and dry.

Do not use metal utensils or sharp objects in the basket. Store the air fryer in a dry, cool place. Do not wrap the cord tightly around the unit; use the cord storage area if provided. Ensure everything is completely dry before storing to prevent mould or odours.
sections.Troubleshooting:
Here are common issues and how to fix them.

The air fryer does not switch on. Check that it is plugged in and the socket is switched on. Ensure the basket is fully inserted; most models have a safety switch that prevents operation if the basket is not locked in place. If it still does not work, try another socket. If the problem continues, contact our support team.

White smoke comes out during cooking. This can happen when cooking fatty foods; fat drips onto the hot element and causes smoke. This is normal but can be reduced by patting food dry, using less oil, and cleaning the basket and heating element regularly. If smoke is excessive or has a strong burning smell, stop using and contact support.

The basket does not slide in smoothly. Check for food debris or crumbs blocking the tracks. Clean the outside of the basket and inside cavity. Do not force it. Ensure the tray is seated correctly inside the basket.

Food is not cooked evenly. Shake or turn food halfway through cooking. Do not overfill the basket. Cook in batches for large amounts. Cut food into similar sizes for even cooking.

Food is not crispy or is too dry. Lightly brush or spray food with a little oil before cooking. Adjust temperature and time. For chips, soak in water for 30 minutes, dry, then toss in a teaspoon of oil before air frying.

Error code on display. Note the code, unplug the appliance, wait 30 seconds, plug it back in. If the code persists, contact support with the code and your order number.

The air fryer is noisy. A gentle fan sound is normal. If there is rattling, ensure the tray is in place and no loose parts are inside. If the noise is very loud or grinding, stop use and contact support.

The basket handle is loose. Stop using and contact support. Do not attempt to fix it yourself.

sections.Safety: Read all instructions before using your ShopAI Home coffee maker. This appliance is for household use only. Do not use outdoors. sections.Setup: Before first use, remove all packaging, stickers, and protective films from the coffee maker and its parts. Keep the box and packing materials for safe transport if needed later. Wash all removable parts, such as the carafe, filter basket, and water tank lid, in warm soapy water. Rinse well and dry completely. Wipe the outside of the machine with a clean, damp cloth. Do not immerse the main body in water. Place the coffee maker on a dry, flat, stable surface near a wall socket. Ensure there is at least 10 cm of space on all sides for airflow. Do not place it under cupboards; steam may damage them. Fill the water tank with clean, cold water using the markings on the tank or the water level window. Do not exceed the maximum line. Use only cold, fresh water. Do not use milk, flavoured liquids, or hot water. Insert the reusable filter or a paper filter into the filter basket as per your model. If using a paper filter, ensure it fits flat and does not fold over. Add ground coffee to the filter. Use medium-grind coffee recommended for drip coffee makers. As a starting guide, use one heaped tablespoon (about 7 grams) of ground coffee per 150 ml of water. Adjust amount to your taste. Close the filter basket and make sure the carafe is correctly placed on the hot plate with the lid closed. Ensure no part of the machine is touching the carafe except the designated support. Plug the coffee maker into a wall socket. Switch on the socket if it has a switch. Press the power button. The indicator light will turn on, and brewing will start within a minute. The first brew may take slightly longer as the system primes. We recommend discarding the first full carafe of coffee after setup to clean the internal pipes. After brewing, the machine may keep the hot plate on to keep the coffee warm. For models with auto shut-off, the machine will turn off automatically after the set time. If your model has a timer or strength selector, set these according to the instructions in the quick start guide provided with your model. Always unplug the coffee maker after use if you leave home for an extended period.
sections.Everyday use: Each time you use the coffee maker, start by ensuring it is clean and dry. Fill the water tank with fresh, cold water up to the desired level using the cup markings. Do not fill above the maximum line. Use the carafe itself to measure water if your model does not have a tank marking. Open the filter basket and place the permanent filter or a fresh paper filter inside. Add the desired amount of ground coffee. Use medium-ground coffee suitable for drip machines. A standard ratio is one heaped tablespoon (about 7 grams) per 150 ml of water. Adjust to suit your taste. If using pre-ground coffee, make sure it is not too fine, as this can clog the filter and cause overflow. If you prefer stronger coffee, add slightly more grounds rather than overfilling the water tank. Close the filter basket securely. Place the empty carafe on the hot plate with its lid closed. Ensure the carafe is centred. Plug in and switch on the coffee maker. Press the start or brew button. The indicator light will glow. The machine will begin to drip hot water over the coffee grounds within a minute. Do not open the filter basket or remove the carafe during brewing. Wait until the dripping stops and the water tank is empty. Once brewing is complete, the hot plate will keep the carafe warm for a set period. If your model has a keep-warm function, the time may be preset or adjustable. If your model has a pause-and-serve feature, you may remove the carafe briefly to pour a cup while brewing, but replace it within 20 seconds to prevent overflow. After you have poured all the coffee, switch off the coffee maker and unplug it. Let the machine cool down before cleaning. Discard the used coffee grounds. If you use paper filters, dispose of them with the grounds. If you use a permanent filter, empty the grounds into a bin and wash the filter. Rinse the carafe and filter basket with warm water after each use. Wipe the exterior with a soft damp cloth if there are any spills. Do not leave stale coffee in the carafe for long periods. Always store the machine clean and dry.
sections.Cleaning and care: Regular cleaning keeps your coffee maker working well and your coffee tasting fresh. Always unplug the machine and let it cool completely before cleaning. Never immerse the main body, power cord, or plug in water or any liquid. Clean the outside with a soft, damp cloth. Do not use abrasive cleaners, scouring pads, or chemical sprays. These can damage the surface. Wipe up spills immediately. Remove the carafe, filter basket, and any other removable parts. Wash them in warm, soapy water after each use. Rinse thoroughly and dry with a soft cloth or allow to air dry. Do not wash removable parts in a dishwasher unless your model's manual states it is dishwasher safe. The filter basket may have small crevices; use a soft brush to remove coffee oils. If your carafe develops coffee stains, fill it with warm water and add a little baking soda or mild detergent. Let it sit for 15 minutes, then scrub gently with a soft sponge. Rinse well. Descale the coffee maker regularly. How often depends on the hardness of your water and how frequently you use the machine. As a general guide, descale every 1 to 2 months, or when you notice longer brewing times, unusual noises, or white mineral deposits. Use a commercial descaling solution suitable for coffee makers, or a mixture of equal parts white vinegar and water. Fill the water tank with the descaling solution up to the maximum level. Place the empty carafe on the hot plate. Run a brew cycle without coffee grounds. After the cycle, discard the solution. Run two more full cycles with fresh, clean water only to rinse internal parts. Wipe the exterior after descaling. If your model has a water filter, replace it according to the manufacturer's instructions, usually every 2 to 3 months. Do not use the coffee maker while it is being descaled. Never submerge the carafe in cold water when it is hot, as it may crack. Let it cool naturally. Store the coffee maker in a dry place, with the lid open to allow air circulation and prevent odours.
sections.Troubleshooting:
If you have a problem with your coffee maker, check this list before contacting support.
- Coffee maker does not turn on: Ensure it is plugged into a working wall socket and switched on. Check that the power button is pressed. Try a different socket. If it still does not start, contact support.
- Coffee is not brewing: Check that the water tank has water. Make sure the filter basket is closed properly and the carafe is on the hot plate. If it still will not brew, the machine may need descaling or have a faulty element.
- Coffee is too weak: Use more ground coffee. Increase the amount by one tablespoon per 150 ml. Ensure you are using a medium grind suitable for drip machines. If the grind is too coarse, extraction will be weak.
- Coffee is too strong or bitter: Use less ground coffee. Check that the grind is not too fine. If using dark roasted coffee, try a lighter roast. Clean the machine, as old coffee oils can make brew bitter.
- Brewing takes too long: The machine may need descaling. Mineral build-up slows heating. Run a descaling cycle. If the problem continues, contact support.
- Coffee grounds in the carafe: If using a paper filter, check it is properly seated and not folded. If using a permanent filter, clean it thoroughly. If the grind is too fine, use a slightly coarser grind.
- Water or coffee overflows from the filter basket: You may have used too much water or too fine a grind. Remove the carafe too long during pause-and-serve can cause overflow. Reduce the water level or use a coarser grind.
- Carafe leaks or drips: Check for cracks or chips. The carafe lid may not be on correctly. If damaged, stop using it and order a replacement.
- Coffee is not hot enough: The hot plate may be turned off or set to a low temperature. Switch on the keep-warm function if available. Pre-heat the carafe with hot water before brewing. If problem persists, contact support.
- Strange noise during brewing: The water pump or heating element may be making noise when the tank is nearly empty. Descale if noise continues.
- Display or lights not working: Unplug the machine, wait one minute, plug it back in. If problem remains, contact support.
- Leaking from the bottom of the machine: Stop using immediately, unplug, and contact support. Do not attempt to open the base.
If none of these solve the issue, contact ShopAI Home support for help. Do not try to repair the machine yourself.
