sections.Setup:
Before using your ShopAI Home toaster or sandwich maker for the first time, please follow these steps carefully. Remove all packaging materials, including any plastic covers, cardboard or stickers from the appliance and its cord. Check that the appliance is clean and free of dust; wipe the exterior with a soft, damp cloth and dry thoroughly. For sandwich makers, open the lid and wipe the non-stick cooking plates with a damp cloth. Do not immerse the appliance in water.

Place the appliance on a dry, flat, heat-resistant surface, away from the edge of the counter and out of reach of children. Ensure there is at least 10 cm of clear space on all sides for proper air circulation. Do not place the appliance under overhead cabinets or near flammable materials.

Plug the power cord into a suitable electrical outlet. Ensure the voltage matches the rating label on the bottom of the appliance. The toaster or sandwich maker is now ready for use.

For toasters, before toasting bread for the first time, run a browning cycle without bread to burn off any protective oils from the heating elements. This may cause a slight odour or smoke; this is normal and will disappear after one or two cycles. For sandwich makers, lightly coat the cooking plates with a small amount of cooking oil or butter, then close the lid and heat for about five minutes. Let it cool, then wipe away any excess oil with a paper towel. This helps condition the non-stick surface.

Read the Everyday use section of this manual for operating instructions. If you have any questions or notice any damage to the appliance or cord, do not use it and contact ShopAI Home support at support@shopai-home.example or via the website chat.
sections.Everyday use:
Using your ShopAI Home toaster:
- Place the toaster on a flat, stable surface and plug it in.
- Set the browning control to your desired level. A lower setting gives lighter toast; a higher setting gives darker toast. For the first use, start with a medium setting to see results.
- Insert one or two slices of bread into the slots. Do not force thick or irregularly shaped bread into the slots; if it does not fit, use thinner slices.
- Press down the lever until it locks into place. The heating elements will turn on and the bread will toast.
- To stop toasting early, press the cancel button. The lever will pop up and the toaster will switch off.
- When the toast is ready, the lever will pop up automatically. Carefully remove the toast, as it and the toaster surfaces will be hot. Do not use metal utensils to remove toast; use wooden or heat-proof plastic tongs.
- Unplug the toaster after use and allow it to cool before moving or cleaning.

Using your ShopAI Home sandwich maker:
- Close the lid and plug in the appliance. The indicator light will turn on, showing that it is heating.
- Wait until the indicator light goes off or changes to the ready colour (per your model) before adding food.
- Open the lid carefully using oven mitts or a dry cloth; the plates are hot.
- Lightly brush the cooking plates with a little oil or butter if desired (especially if your plates are not fully non-stick).
- Place your prepared sandwich or ingredients on the bottom plate. Do not overfill; a thin layer is best.
- Close the lid gently and lock the latch if provided. Do not force the lid shut.
- Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, depending on your recipe and desired crispness. Check occasionally; the indicator light may cycle on and off as the thermostat maintains temperature.
- When cooked, open the lid carefully and remove the food with a plastic or wooden spatula. Never use metal utensils as they can scratch the non-stick surface.
- Unplug the appliance and let it cool completely before cleaning.

Always supervise the appliance while in use. Do not leave it unattended.
sections.Cleaning and care:
Regular cleaning keeps your toaster or sandwich maker in good working condition and prevents unpleasant odours or smoke. Always unplug the appliance and allow it to cool completely before cleaning. Never immerse the appliance, cord or plug in water or any other liquid.

For toasters:
- Remove and empty the crumb tray after each use or at least once a week. Most models have a removable tray at the bottom; slide it out, discard crumbs, wipe with a damp cloth, dry thoroughly and slide it back.
- If your toaster does not have a removable crumb tray, turn the toaster upside down over a bin and gently shake out the crumbs. Do not tap the toaster hard or insert any objects into the slots.
- Wipe the exterior with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Do not use abrasive cleaners, scouring pads or chemical sprays. Avoid getting any liquid inside the toaster.
- Do not clean the inside of the toaster with water or any cleaning solution. The heating elements will burn off any small crumbs.

For sandwich makers:
- After the appliance has cooled, wipe the cooking plates with a paper towel or a soft, damp cloth to remove any food residue. For stubborn stains, apply a small amount of mild dish soap to a damp cloth and wipe gently; then wipe with a clean damp cloth to remove soap.
- Never use metal scourers, sharp objects or abrasive cleaning powders; they will damage the non-stick coating.
- Do not put the appliance in a dishwasher.
- Wipe the exterior and the handle with a damp cloth and dry.
- If food is baked on, close the lid and heat the appliance for a minute or two to soften the residue, then wipe carefully with a damp cloth while warm (but not hot enough to burn).

Always ensure all parts are completely dry before storing or using the appliance. Store in a clean, dry place with the cord loosely coiled; do not wrap the cord tightly around the appliance.
sections.Troubleshooting:
If you experience a problem with your ShopAI Home toaster or sandwich maker, check the list below for common issues and solutions. If the problem continues, please contact support@shopai-home.example or use the website chat.

- Toaster does not turn on / no heating: Check that the appliance is plugged in and the outlet is working. Try another outlet. Ensure the lever is fully pressed down. If still no heat, the appliance may be faulty; stop using it and contact support.

- Toast comes out too light or too dark: Adjust the browning control to a higher or lower setting. Different breads toast differently; fresher bread needs a higher setting. If you are toasting cold bread, allow it to come to room temperature first.

- Toaster smell or smoke on first use: This is normal for a new toaster due to burning off manufacturing oils. Run two or three empty toasting cycles in a well-ventilated area. If smoke persists, unplug and check crumbs.

- Toast is unevenly browned: Crumbs may have accumulated on one side; clean the crumb tray. Ensure bread slices are of even thickness. If the problem persists, the heating elements may be faulty; contact support.

- Lever does not stay down: The toaster is not plugged in, or the bread is too thin and has lifted the lever. Plug in the toaster. If the lever still pops up immediately, contact support.

- Food stuck in toaster: Unplug the toaster and let it cool. Turn it upside down over a bin and gently shake. Do not use metal objects to remove food.

- Sandwich maker does not heat up: Check the power connection and outlet. The indicator light should be on when heating. If not, the appliance may be faulty; contact support.

- Sandwich maker indicator light never goes off: This is normal for some models; the thermostat cycles the light. If the plates do not heat, contact support.

- Food sticks to the plates: Lightly oil the plates before each use. Do not use metal utensils. If the non-stick coating is scratched, the appliance may still work but more oil will be needed.

- Smoke or burning smell during sandwich making: Some oil or butter may have dripped onto the heating element. Wipe the edges of the plates. Reduce the amount of filling or butter.

sections.Safety:
Please read all instructions before using your ShopAI Home headphones or earbuds. Keep this manual for future reference.
- Do not listen at high volumes for long periods. This can damage your hearing. A safe level is one where you can still hear people around you.
- Be careful when using headphones or earbuds while walking, cycling, or driving. They can block out traffic sounds and cause accidents. Do not use them where being unaware of your surroundings is dangerous.
- Keep the product away from water and moisture. Do not use in rain, near sinks, or in humid places. If they get wet, dry them completely before use.
- Do not use damaged headphones or earbuds, especially if the cable is frayed or the casing is cracked. This can lead to electric shock or injury.
- Keep small parts, such as ear tips, away from children. They are a choking hazard.
- Do not insert earbuds too deeply into your ears. If they feel uncomfortable, try a different size ear tip or adjust the fit.
- Stop using if you feel discomfort, pain, or irritation in your ears or skin. See a doctor if symptoms continue.
- Use only the charging cable or case provided or bought from ShopAI Home. Using the wrong charger can damage the battery or cause fire.
- Do not expose the product to extreme heat, such as inside a car on a hot day, or to open flames.
- The built-in battery should be charged before first use and if not used for a long time. Do not leave the device plugged in for days continuously.
- If the battery leaks or swells, stop using immediately and contact ShopAI Home support. Do not try to repair or replace the battery yourself.
- Keep away from pacemakers and other medical devices. The magnets and electronics may cause interference.
sections.Setup:
Thank you for buying ShopAI Home headphones or earbuds. Follow these steps to start using them.

For earbuds, take them out of the case; they usually enter pairing mode automatically. If not, press and hold the button on the case or earbuds. Look for the device name in your Bluetooth list and select it. If asked for a passcode, enter 0000.

- Controls: Learn the buttons or touch areas. Common controls: short press to play/pause, long press for voice assistant, double press for next track. Volume may be controlled by buttons or swipes. See the quick start guide in the box for model-specific details.

sections.Everyday use:
Your ShopAI Home headphones or earbuds are designed for easy daily use.
- Power and connection: Headphones have a power button. Press and hold to turn on or off. Earbuds turn on when taken out of the case and off when placed back. They will automatically connect to the last paired device if Bluetooth is on.
- Play music and calls: Use the controls to play, pause, skip tracks, and answer or end calls. The microphone is built-in. For best call quality, keep the device within 10 metres of your phone.
- Volume: Adjust volume from your phone or on the device. Be careful not to set it too high.
- Voice assistant: Many models support Google Assistant or Siri. Press and hold the main button to activate.
- Battery life: Battery life varies. On average, headphones last 15-20 hours of playback. Earbuds last 4-6 hours, with extra charges from the case (usually 2-3 full charges). Check the product page for exact figures.
- Charging: Use the supplied cable. Plug into any USB power source. A full charge takes about 1-2 hours. The LED will show red while charging and blue or off when complete.
- Pairing a new device: Turn off Bluetooth on the old device, then put the headphones or earbuds into pairing mode and select them on the new device.
- Reset if needed: If the device is not working properly, you can reset it. Usually, press and hold the power and volume up buttons together for 10 seconds. The LED will flash. Then pair again.
- Using with multiple devices: Some models can connect to two devices at once, e.g., phone and laptop. Refer to the model guide for details.
- Storage: When not in use, keep the device in its case or a clean, dry place. Turn off headphones to save battery.
sections.Cleaning and care:
Regular cleaning keeps your headphones or earbuds working well and hygienic.
- Before cleaning, turn off the device and unplug any cables. For earbuds, remove the ear tips.
- Wipe the outside: Use a soft, dry, lint-free cloth. Dampen it slightly with water, but do not let water enter any openings. Do not use alcohol, solvents, or abrasive cleaners.
- Clean the ear cushions (headphones): Remove them if possible. Wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Let them dry completely before reattaching.
- Clean the ear tips (earbuds): Remove the silicone tips. Wash them in warm soapy water. Rinse well and dry fully before putting them back. Replace them if they are torn or misshapen. You can buy replacements from ShopAI Home.
- Clean the mesh and nozzles: Gently brush away earwax or dust with a dry, soft-bristled brush (like a clean toothbrush). Do not push dirt inside. Never insert pins or sharp objects.
- Charging contacts: Wipe the metal contacts on the earbuds and inside the case with a dry cotton swab. If dirty, the earbuds may not charge.
- Storage: Keep in the case (for earbuds) or a pouch (for headphones). Avoid damp or very dusty places. Do not wrap the cable tightly around the device; this can damage wires.
- Avoid extreme temperatures: Do not leave in direct sunlight or a hot car. Heat can damage the battery.
- Battery care: The battery lasts longer if you keep it between 20% and 80%. Avoid full discharge often. If not using for a month or more, charge it to about 50% first.
- Water resistance: Most models are not waterproof. Do not wear them in the shower or rain. If they get wet, wipe immediately and let dry for 24 hours before use.
- If you notice reduced sound quality, check for earwax build-up in the mesh and clean as directed. If the problem continues, contact ShopAI Home support.
sections.Troubleshooting:
Here are common problems and how to fix them. If your problem continues, contact support@shopai-home.example or use the chat on our website.
- Problem: Headphones or earbuds do not turn on.
  Fix: Charge them for at least 30 minutes. Make sure the charger and cable are working. Try a different USB port. For earbuds, ensure the case has charge and the earbuds are seated correctly.
- Problem: Not pairing with phone.
  Fix: Turn off Bluetooth on your phone and on again. Put the device in pairing mode: for headphones, hold power button until LED flashes; for earbuds, take them out of case and hold the case button if needed. Forget the device in your phone's Bluetooth list, then search again. Ensure no other device is connected.
- Problem: Sound cuts in and out.
  Fix: Move closer to your phone, ideally within 5 metres. Remove obstacles like walls or bodies. Check for interference from Wi-Fi routers or other Bluetooth devices. Recharge the battery; low battery can cause drops. Reset the device and pair again.
- Problem: One earbud is not working.
  Fix: Put both earbuds back in the case for 10 seconds, then take them out. Check if they are charged. Clean the charging contacts. Reset the earbuds as per the manual.
- Problem: Low volume or muffled sound.
  Fix: Increase volume on both the device and your phone. Clean the ear tips and mesh. Try a different size ear tip for better seal. Check if your phone's audio balance is centred.
- Problem: Microphone not working during calls.
  Fix: Ensure the microphone holes are not blocked or dirty. Clean gently with a dry brush. Check your phone settings to allow the device as microphone. Move away from wind or noise.
- Problem: Headphones not charging.
  Fix: Check the cable and port for damage. Try another charging brick. Clean the charging port on the headphones. The LED should light up. If not, contact support.
- Problem: Earbuds not charging in case.
  Fix: Clean the metal contacts on the earbuds and inside the case with a dry cloth. Close the case lid properly. Charge the case itself; if the case battery is empty, it won't charge the earbuds.
- Problem: Device pairs but no audio.
  Fix: In your phone's Bluetooth settings, ensure media audio is enabled. Restart the phone. Disconnect and reconnect. Try playing from a different app.
- If none of these solve the issue, please contact ShopAI Home support. Do not open or repair the device yourself, as this voids the warranty.
